title: elench release artifact (v0.1)
description: Carries (tree, policy), NOT a verdict (INV-15). Consumers re-evaluate the release gate at consumption time using the current claim log. The artifact is distributed independently of the claim log — anyone with both can re-evaluate. If a load-bearing claim is falsified after release, the artifact's status changes with no byte moving and no re-signing (R4).

version.description: Artifact format version. Consumers SHOULD reject artifacts with unknown major versions. Current: '0.1'.

tree.description: The elench tree OID this artifact was built from. NOT a git commit — an elench content address (ADR-0001).

policy.description: The policy name under which the artifact was released. Consumers re-evaluate the gate using a policy with this name.

digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the artifact (e.g., binary, container image). This is what condition 4 (builder agreement) checks: K independent producers have signed statements with this digest as the subject.

released_at.description: Unix epoch seconds. Set by the producer at release time. NOT a verdict — consumers re-evaluate.
